turn_risk_heldout.note: Temporal split per index: bins fit on the first 60% of scored sessions, Brier-scored on the last 40%. Indexes whose conditional model does not beat their base rate publish base-rate turn-risk (see turn_risk_model per row).

method.regime_rule: gap = close/SMA200 - 1; raw BULL >= +2%, BEAR <= -2%, else RANGE; a differing raw state must hold 5 consecutive sessions to confirm a flip, stamped on the confirmation session.
method.breadth: Share of constituents whose own last close is above their own 50-session SMA (>=50 own bars, bar within 12 calendar days). Today's sector map applied historically (survivorship caveat).
method.forecast_confidence: Measured persistence from replaying the rule over full history: of all past sessions in the index's current state, the share still in that state h sessions later. Measured history, not a model prediction.
method.turn_risk: P(confirmed regime no longer holds 10 sessions later), empirical binned frequencies (age percentile x band distance x adverse breadth trend) with backoff + smoothing toward the state base rate; base-rate fallback where the conditional model fails held-out validation.
method.confidence_tier: Banded from measured 10-session persistence of the current state: HIGH >= 0.80, MEDIUM 0.65-0.80, LOW < 0.65; withheld for thin indexes (< 10 constituents).
method.derived_indexes: Sector rows are derived equal-weight composites of constituent stocks (data/sector-indices.json), not official NEPSE sub-indices; the All-Share Composite is contributor-weighted across sectors. The NEPSE row is the official index.

notes: data/index-history.json is missing 4 sessions present in the symbol archive (2026-09-22, 23, 24, 28); NEPSE session counts (incl. days_in_regime) use the recorded sessions.
Sector membership is today's map applied historically; delisted names are absent (survivorship).
